steps.name: Find the changed Vale paths
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# The only list of paths that run the Vale steps on a pull request.
paths=(
  "README.md"
  "**/README.md"
  "CONTRIBUTING.md"
  "AGENTS.md"
  "ROADMAP.md"
  "docs/decisions/**"
  "docs/design/**"
  "docs/THESIS.md"
  "docs/JOURNEY.md"
  "docs/WORKING-MODEL.md"
  "docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md"
  "docs/GLOSSARY.md"
  "docs/INDEX.md"
  "docs/STYLE.md"
  "docs/templates/**"
  ".github/**/*.md"
  "bin/check-voice*.sh"
  "bin/mutate-voice.sh"
  "tests/voice-changed-head.sh"
  "tests/voice-changed-links.sh"
  ".vale.ini"
  ".vale/**"
  ".github/workflows/vale.yml"
)
if [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" != "pull_request" ]]; then
  echo "Not a pull request, so every Vale step runs."
  echo "lint=true" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi
# HEAD is the PR merge commit; its first parent is the base branch.
changed="$(git diff --name-only HEAD^1 HEAD -- "${paths[@]/#/:(glob)}")"
if [[ -z "$changed" ]]; then
  echo "No Vale path changed in this pull request. Skipping the Vale steps."
  echo "lint=false" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "Vale paths changed in this pull request:"
  printf '%s\n' "$changed"
  echo "lint=true" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Install Vale
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
url="https://github.com/vale-cli/vale/releases/download/v${VALE_VERSION}/vale_${VALE_VERSION}_Linux_64-bit.tar.gz"
sha="4bf5c5176b682b1da0830f471584d3494f1c2e27ee3029e1ad6f6661d4962182"
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/vale"
curl -fsSL -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/vale.tgz" "$url"
echo "$sha  $RUNNER_TEMP/vale.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xz -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/vale" -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/vale.tgz" vale
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/vale" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Enforce Vale on the clean set (error level blocks)
Check the fixtures (strict config)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for bad in .vale/fixtures/bad-*.md; do
  good="${bad/bad-/good-}"
  if vale --config .vale/strict.ini "$bad" >/dev/null; then
    echo "::error::$bad passed but must fail"; exit 1
  fi
  vale --config .vale/strict.ini "$good" >/dev/null \
    || { echo "::error::$good must pass"; exit 1; }
done
